name: Jen
source:
Jen is another one of Roy's sexually corrupted female conquests. 

It is unknown if her current sexual slavery to Roy was consensual or not. 

Roy introduces Jen into the story to further destabilize Emily.

She also makes Emily question why she is jealous of Jen spending time with Roy since Emily thought she was a Lesbian.
